## Load libraries
```{r libraries, cache=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
library(tidyverse)
library(rrrSingleCellUtils)
library(Seurat)
future::plan("multicore", workers = parallelly::availableCores())
options(future.globals.maxSize = 3000 * 1024^2)
```

## Intratumoral Heterogeneity
```{r}
pre_path <- "~/../lab/Counts_2/"
post_path <- "/filtered_feature_bc_matrix"
samples <- tribble(
  ~id, ~model, ~mt_cutoff, ~count_cutoff, ~species,
  # "S0015", "OS-17", 18, 80000, "^GRCh38-",
  "S0016", "OS-17", 18, 120000, "^GRCh38-"
  # "S0056", "OS-17", 20, 90000, "^GRCh38-"
)

s <- 1
pdx_lungs <- tenx_load_qc(
    paste0(pre_path, samples$id[s], post_path),
    species_pattern = samples$species[s],
    violin_plot = FALSE
  ) %>%
  subset(
    percent.mt < samples$mt_cutoff[s] &
    nCount_RNA < samples$count_cutoff[s]
  ) %>%
  NormalizeData()
pdx_lungs$id <- samples$id[s]
pdx_lungs$model <- samples$model[s]

pdx_lungs <- pdx_lungs %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 5000) %>%
  ScaleData() %>%
  RunPCA()

pdx_lungs <- pdx_lungs %>%
  FindNeighbors(reduction = "pca", k.param = 100L) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.8) %>%
  RunUMAP(reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)

r_dim_plot(pdx_lungs)

g <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(
  adjmatrix = pdx_lungs@graphs$RNA_snn,
  mode = "undirected",
  weighted = TRUE,
  add.colnames = TRUE)

fdl <- igraph::layout_with_fr(g, grid = "nogrid")
rownames(fdl) <- colnames(pdx_lungs)
colnames(fdl) <- c("fdl_1", "fdl_2")

pdx_lungs[["fdl"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = fdl,
  key = "fdl_",
  assay = DefaultAssay(pdx_lungs))

r_dim_plot(pdx_lungs, reduction = "fdl")

pdx_lungs <- kill_cc (pdx_lungs)

r_dim_plot(pdx_lungs)
Idents(pdx_lungs) <- pdx_lungs$seurat_clusters

lungs_basal <- subset(pdx_lungs, idents = c(0, 2, 4, 8))
lungs_basal_marks <- FindAllMarkers(lungs_basal)

lungs_basal_marks %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05 & pct.1 > 0.3) %>%
  mutate(diff = pct.1 - pct.2) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  arrange(-diff) %>%
  top_n(n = 30, wt = diff) %>%
  gt::gt()

r_feature_plot(pdx_lungs, c("PAX7", "FABP5", "SMOC1"), max.cutoff = 1.0, reduction = "fdl", ncol = 3)
```

## Test cell cycle regression
```{r}
pdx_lungs_cc <- pdx_lungs %>%
  ScaleData(
    vars.to.regress = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score"),
    features = rownames(x = pdx_lungs)) %>%
  RunPCA() %>%
  FindNeighbors(reduction = "pca", k.param = 100L) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.8) %>%
  RunUMAP(reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)

r_dim_plot(pdx_lungs_cc, group.by = "Phase")

g <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(
  adjmatrix = pdx_lungs_cc@graphs$RNA_snn,
  mode = "undirected",
  weighted = TRUE,
  add.colnames = TRUE)

fdl <- igraph::layout_with_fr(g, grid = "nogrid")
rownames(fdl) <- colnames(pdx_lungs_cc)
colnames(fdl) <- c("fdl_1", "fdl_2")

pdx_lungs_cc[["fdl"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = fdl,
  key = "fdl_",
  assay = DefaultAssay(pdx_lungs_cc))

r_dim_plot(pdx_lungs_cc, group.by = "seurat_clusters", reduction = "fdl")
r_feature_plot(pdx_lungs_cc, "PAX7", reduction = "fdl")
```

## GSEA
```{r}
degs <- FindAllMarkers(pdx_lungs_cc) %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(-avg_log2FC)

pathways <- mclapply(unique(degs$cluster), function(clust) {
  genes <- degs %>%
    filter(cluster == clust)

  p <- clusterProfiler::gseGO(
    geneList = genes,
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.ed.db,
    ont = "BP",
    keyType = "SYMBOL",
    nPermSimple = 10000,
    eps = 0
  )

  return(p)
}, mc.cores = parallelly::availableCores())
```
